title: Bananarr - Technology Profiler | Peel Back the Tech Stack of Any Website
excerpt: Bananarr is a gorgeous, blazing-fast, 100% local technology profiler Chrome extension that inspects any website's tech stack. Zero tracking, zero bloat.
content_html:
Chrome Extension

A gorgeous, blazing-fast, and offline-first technology profiler Chrome extension
to inspect any website's tech stack. No accounts, no bloat, pure speed.

Add to Chrome

Default keyboard shortcut:

Mac: ⌥ + B

/

Windows: Alt + B

shield_with_heart No App Servers bolt Instant Scans extension Chrome Extension

security Privacy is Not a Feature, It's a Right

Popular dev detectors send every domain you visit to external servers under the guise of "updating signature caches". This data is often packaged and sold to corporate databases to track internet tech trends.

Bananarr packages its matcher locally. It has no account system or app backend API, while active-tab header and DNS checks are used only for HTTP and hosting/IP evidence.

check_circle

No Remote Backend

The signature database and matching logic are packaged locally inside the extension. No app server or user account is required.

check_circle

Lightning Fast

Signatures match locally against in-memory data, so scans complete within seconds on a typical page.

bar_chart Dev Tools Privacy Comparison

Bananarr

Privacy-First stack detector

Bundled Signatures No Analytics No Ads

📊

BuiltWith / Wappalyzer

Corporate stack trackers

Sends URLs Data Tracking

Don't let the lightweight size fool you. Bananarr is custom-tailored to pack everything a modern developer needs.

bolt

Dual-World Scan

Scans DOM selectors, scripts, links, images, cookies, and meta tags in the isolated extension world, then reads page-defined window globals from the main world.

palette

Vibrant Color Categories

Instantly groups detected tech across color-coded categories, from languages, backend, frontend, CSS, CMS, and e-commerce to hosting, analytics, security, payments, and engagement widgets.

cloud

Local Signature & IP Engines

Bundled signatures cover frameworks, payments, CDNs, hosting, and libraries. Active-tab header and DNS checks feed a local IP range database for AWS, Cloudflare, Fastly, Akamai, Google Cloud, Azure, and more.

fact_check

Every Detection Comes with Evidence

Every technology match is paired with the evidence that triggered it, including meta tags, script, link, and image URLs, globals, cookies, headers, DOM elements, IP ranges, or implied relationships.

heart_broken

No Account Requirements

No sign-ups, accounts, trials, upgrade prompts, or query quotas. Install the extension and inspect the active tab immediately.

extension

Modern Extension Security

Built on modern Chrome extension rules with tab-scoped scripting permissions, plus a narrow DNS host permission for IP resolution. Scans only the current active tab when you run it.

A simple, highly secure pipeline that finishes in a fraction of a frame.

1

🔔

Trigger Scan

Click the Bananarr icon or press Mac: ⌥ + B / Windows: Alt + B . Bananarr requests tab scripting permissions dynamically.

2

🔍

Dual-World Injection

The extension injects a DOM scanner and a globals scanner to compile metadata, selectors, scripts, and variables from the tab.

3

🎯

Instant Offline Match

The scanner sends data back to the popup, which matches against the signature list and lists results organized by category.

Install Bananarr from the Chrome Web Store and instantly start profiling technology stacks.

Add to Chrome

Default keyboard shortcut:

Mac: ⌥ + B

/

Windows: Alt + B

🍌

Shortcut Triggered!

You pressed Mac: ⌥ + B / Windows: Alt + B . Once installed, this opens the extension instantly.

content_html_zh:
Chrome 扩展程序

一个华丽、速度极快、离线优先的技术分析器 Chrome 扩展，用于检查任何网站的技术堆栈。 没有账户，没有臃肿，纯粹的速度。

添加到 Chrome

默认键盘快捷键：

Mac: ⌥ + B

/

Windows：Alt + B

shield_with_heart 无应用程序服务器螺栓即时扫描扩展 Chrome 扩展

安全隐私不是一项功能，而是一项权利

流行的开发检测器以“更新签名缓存”为幌子，将您访问的每个域发送到外部服务器。 这些数据通常被打包并出售给企业数据库，以跟踪互联网技术趋势。

Bananarr 在本地打包其匹配器。 它没有帐户系统或应用程序后端 API，而活动选项卡标头和 DNS 检查仅用于 HTTP 和托管/IP 证据。

检查圆

无远程后端

签名数据库和匹配逻辑本地打包在扩展内。 不需要应用程序服务器或用户帐户。

检查圆

快如闪电

签名在本地与内存中的数据进行匹配，因此扫描在典型页面上几秒钟内即可完成。

bar_chart 开发工具隐私比较

巴纳纳尔

隐私第一堆栈检测器

捆绑签名 无分析 无广告

📊

内置 / Wappalyzer

企业堆栈跟踪器

发送 URL 数据跟踪

不要让轻巧的尺寸欺骗了您。 Bananarr 是定制的，可以满足现代开发人员所需的一切。

bolt

双重世界扫描

扫描隔离扩展世界中的 DOM 选择器、脚本​​、链接、图像、cookie 和元标记，然后从主世界读取页面定义的窗口全局变量。

调色板

鲜艳的色彩类别

立即将检测到的技术按颜色编码类别进行分组，从语言、后端、前端、CSS、CMS 和电子商务到托管、分析、安全、支付和参与小部件。

cloud

本地签名和 IP 引擎

捆绑签名涵盖框架、支付、CDN、托管和库。 活动选项卡标头和 DNS 检查为 AWS、Cloudflare、Fastly、Akamai、Google Cloud、Azure 等提供本地 IP 范围数据库。

事实检查

每一次检测都有证据

每个技术匹配都与触发它的证据配对，包括元标记、脚本、链接和图像 URL、全局变量、cookie、标头、DOM 元素、IP 范围或隐含关系。

肠断

无账户要求

没有注册、帐户、试用、升级提示或查询配额。 安装扩展并立即检查活动选项卡。

扩大

现代扩展安全

基于现代 Chrome 扩展规则构建，具有选项卡范围的脚本权限，以及用于 IP 解析的狭窄 DNS 主机权限。 运行时仅扫描当前活动选项卡。

一个简单、高度安全的管道，只需一帧的一小部分即可完成。

单击 Bananarr 图标或按 Mac： ⌥ + B / Windows： Alt + B 。 Bananarr 动态请求选项卡脚本权限。

该扩展注入了 DOM 扫描器和全局扫描器来编译选项卡中的元数据、选择器、脚本​​和变量。
